title: After the Weather
alt_text: Dawn opening over a mist-filled mountain lake
story: He carried two cups to the lake, out of a habit he had not yet learned to lose. The mountains kept their distance behind the mist. When the light finally arrived, it found him sitting on the old log, explaining the weather to no one in particular. By the time the light reached the shore, both cups were cold. He stayed a little longer anyway.
